title: KQL: the query language the whole platform answers in

videos.script: Logs, traces, the activity log, the bill exported to a table. In Azure, all of them answer in one language. {{one}} KQL reads like a pipe. A table goes in at the top. Each line filters it, or adds a column, or counts it. What comes out at the bottom is the answer. {{pipe}} In this lesson you ask the shop's week of requests five questions. Which ones failed. When. How slow, honestly. Whose problem. {{questions}} By the end, Thursday afternoon will have a start time and an owner. {{end}}
